<a name="model-all"></a>
### `->all()`

```php
public function all($args = array())
```

Fetches all the records, optionally completed by SQL clauses

**Parameters**

+ `$args` `array`, default `array()`: 'condition' (ex: 'WHERE price &gt; ?'), 'order' (ex: 'ORDER BY title'), 'limit' (ex: 'LIMIT 10') and 'bindings' (array of values bound to the ? placeholders). The clauses are inserted as is: never concatenate user input in them, use ? placeholders and 'bindings' instead.

Source: [framework/core/Model.php:176](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/Model.php#L176)

<a name="model-search"></a>
### `->search()`

```php
public function search($scope, $keywords)
```

Search functionality that searched records in a table

**Parameters**

+ `$scope` `string`: defines the columns to search in the database separated by commas
+ `$keywords` `string`: defines the LIKE pattern to look for (% and _ are wildcards). It is bound, never inlined.

**Returns** `array`: $result results found in the database

Source: [framework/core/Model.php:205](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/Model.php#L205)

<a name="model-hasone"></a>
### `->hasOne()`

```php
public function hasOne(
    $modelName,
    $joinedTableName,
    $foreignKey = null,
    $localKey = null,
    $functionName = null
)
```

Defines the hasOne relationship

**Parameters**

+ `$modelName` `string`: defines the name of the model to join to
+ `$joinedTableName` `string`: defines the name of the table to join to
+ `$foreignKey` `string`, default `null`: defines the identifier key of the key indexing the joined table
+ `$localKey` `string`, default `null`: defines the identifier key of the joined table
+ `$functionName`, default `null`

**Returns** `Model`: object containing the records from the join
